SELECT d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039, d.XCL_041
FROM drivers AS d
WHERE d.XCL_034 IN (
    SELECT lt.XCL_044
    FROM lapTimes AS lt
    WHERE lt.XCL_047 LIKE '%.488'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM qualifying AS q
          WHERE q.XCL_058 = lt.XCL_044
            AND q.XCL_057 = lt.XCL_043
            AND q.XCL_063 LIKE '%1:15%'
      )
)
ORDER BY d.XCL_040 ASC
LIMIT 1
